editorial_workflow.subtitle: Claim, evidence, reason, next check
editorial_workflow.description: Mark what is unknown, disputed or provisional; explain why, link the evidence and write a specific next check. Keep earlier reasoning when updating the note. These labels describe the state of your investigation, not a measured probability.
